description: This PHP class 'JobTitle' extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable'. It belongs to the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField', and defines methods to modify query builders based on job title filters, convert filter values to array representations, and retrieve entity aliases. It is part of the OrangeHRM system's reporting filter functionality, specifically for filtering employees based on job titles.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Represents a filter field for job titles in the reporting system. Provides methods to modify query builders with job title conditions, normalize value representations, and access related entity information.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the provided QueryBuilderWrapper to include a condition on the employee's job title if the operator is 'EQUAL' and the filter value (X) is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases relevant for this filter, specifically ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the filter's value (X) into an array containing the job title's ID and label if the job title entity is valid; otherwise returns null.
